messages.1ターン目の守備「脚力。解放。ふっ。」で「脚力【卯】」を得て速度10以上を狙いや: A Slash attacker that uses Strider. Unleashed. Heh on turn 1 to gain Strider【Mao】 and more easily reach 10 Speed. Reused S1 Blinkstep and a powerful S3 deal damage while sustaining Rupture Count; allies supply Rupture Potency.
messages.脚力【卯】: S3と守備(マッチ可能反撃)の使用時に3を得る(最大3)。ターン終: **Strider【Mao】**: Gains 3 on using S3 and her Defense skill (a clashable counter), up to 3. At Turn End, she gains 5 Haste next turn and then loses 1, so gaining 3 provides 5 Haste three times. Her Defense skill is only used when it Clashes with an attack skill, and otherwise grants no Strider.
messages.速度10以上: S1・S3はコインを1回再使用(スキルごとに1回)。S2「刻まれ: **10 or more Speed**: S1 and S3 reuse a Coin once (once per skill). S2 As Written adds +1 Rupture Count with Coin Ⅰ and +10/20/30% damage with Coin Ⅱ, and S3 gains +30% damage with Coin Ⅲ. Her Speed range is 3–6/3–7/4–7, so even with 5 Haste her minimum is 8/8/9, and 10 or more Speed is not guaranteed.
messages.S2のクイック: 速度に関係なく、使用時に次のターンのクイック2を得る(1ターン: **S2's Haste**: Regardless of Speed, grants 2 Haste next turn on use, once per turn. Combined with Strider's 5 Haste, it raises her minimum Speed next turn.
messages.速度差と破裂で強化: S1・S2は速度が対象より3以上高ければコイン威力+1、対: **Bonuses from Speed difference and Rupture**: S1 and S2 gain +1 Coin Power if she is at least 3 Speed faster than the target, and +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6/4 Rupture. S2 and S3 gain (Speed difference × target's Rupture Potency)% damage, up to 50%.
messages.破裂回数の維持: S1はマッチ勝利時とⅡコインで破裂回数+1、S3はマッチ勝利時: **Maintaining Rupture Count**: S1 adds +1 Rupture Count on Clash Win and with Coin Ⅱ, S3 adds +2 on Clash Win and +1 with Coin Ⅰ, and her Defense skill adds +1 with Coin Ⅰ. The Rupture Potency she inflicts is small, around 1–3.
messages.呪殺【迅速】: S3のⅠコインと再使用コインで付与。速度10以上の相手の攻撃で破: **Deathrite【Haste】**: Inflicted by Coin Ⅰ and the reused Coin of S3. It decreases by 1 each time Rupture triggers from an attack by someone with 10 or more Speed, and each time the bearer's Rupture Count increases by 1. When it reaches 0, it deals Gluttony damage equal to Rupture Potency.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「黒獣化[卯]」(暴食×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得)は、: **Passives**: The combat passive Heishou Mutation [Mao] (3 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +5% damage while she has Strider【Mao】, and +5% more if the target has Deathrite【Haste】. The support passive Partial Heishou Mutation Training (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives the 1 fastest ally 2 Haste next turn at Turn End.
messages.1ターン目は守備で敵の攻撃とマッチして脚力【卯】を得る。2ターン目以降、速度が1: On turn 1, Clash an enemy attack with her Defense skill to gain Strider【Mao】. From turn 2 on, if her Speed is 10 or more, prioritize S1, which becomes 3 attacks with reuse, and use S2 when you need Clash Power or when her Speed falls short of 10. S3 also grants Strider, so fire it while maintaining it. S3 is much weaker below 10 Speed. Pairing her with allies who can inflict Rupture Potency extends the Speed difference × Rupture Potency damage bonus.
